Welcome to Sarpy County
The fastest-growing county in the state of Nebraska, Sarpy County is a vibrant community of close-knit neighbors, thriving businesses and unforgettable experiences. Our mission is to improve your quality of life and provide exceptional, accessible and cost-effective public services.

We Want to Hear From You!
Sarpy County is building a strategic plan to map out its priorities over the next 3 years. The process starts with the people who live here. What matters most to you? Join us for a community forum the week of Oct. 13 and/or take our survey. Shape Sarpy's Future
